I am a young man in Mwanza with only a small piece of land, just over a third of a hectare, so I must make it count for my family's nsima. I will try to buy a little fertilizer through the AIP subsidy if I can get a coupon, but money is tight so I cannot apply the full recommended amount — I will stretch what I have. I keep a few chickens and goats, so I put their manure in the planting holes to help the soil, and I intercrop with pigeon peas and pumpkins like my neighbors do. I depend on the rains since I have no pump, and most of the work I do myself with my wife, only calling a few people for ganyu at weeding time.
